descriptor.retrieval_description: Opaque plastic container with a smooth, dry, flat-sided rectangular prism body with rounded corners. The intended contact region is clean, flat to slightly curved at the edges, and uninterrupted by seams.
descriptor.contact_region: Opposing lateral flat sides of the rectangular plastic container
descriptor.local_geometry: Flat planar surfaces with rounded vertical corner edges
descriptor.uncertainty: The lateral contact regions are partially obscured by the top-down viewing angle, though the prismatic body geometry is clear.
